mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% within a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, elevated housing starts (HOUST > 1400.0) signal robust consumer demand and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 1400.0 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and manufacturing output, which supports corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year) signals persistent inflationary pressures that may trigger central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative equity returns as real rates rise and growth expectations moderate, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0%), a low unemployment rate signals strong consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0% and the labor market is tight, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
